title: Mixed Event — Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back — Episode3 Trouble at the Recital?!

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back
meta.Event Outline: It's almost time for the Miya Girls choir recital. Honami is selected as the coordinator for her class, but it's hard to coordinate when everyone's opinions are split right down the middle! What is kindness? Stuck between a rock and a hard place, Honami gives her answer...!

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Class, it's time we started preparing for the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We have to sing two songs, one that will be given to us and another of your choice. During today's homeroom, let's try to decide which song we should sing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh! I completely forgot about the recital because of MEIKO. We're supposed to start preparing for it today?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho said it'd be a pain, but I'm actually looking forward to singing with everyone in the class.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The choir recital...!
Oh boy!! I can't wait!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we can put a smile on everyone's faces like for the Sports Festival! Let's have fun and sing our way to gold!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Otori, I know you're all fired up, but try to stay in your seat, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwaagh! I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I agree with her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival helped the class to get along, so hopefully that will help us pull off a good recital.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To help things go smoothly, I'd like to appoint a coordinator for the recital who isn't the class representative.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, would you be up to the task?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
Wh-Who, me?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, you. I believe you have what it takes to handle this. So what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not sure if I can...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have band practice too, and what if I end up dragging the entire class down instead?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I want to try...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'll give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Good. I'll leave today's homeroom session up to you then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thanks to everyone, I can be more honest about my feelings with my classmates so...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I want to do what I can to make the recital fun for all of them!)
After school - Homeroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, for today's homeroom, we'll be selecting a song to sing for the competition and planning out a practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let's start with the song.
Does anyone have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me, me, me!
Let's do "Smile Tomorrow Too"!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a happy and cheerful song that's bound to put a smile on everyone's face♪

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I vote for Otori's choice too! It'll be a bit hard to learn, but the challenge will be worth it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Plus, that was the song that won gold last year, right? We might as well aim for that too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. Does anyone else have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yes. How about "The Voice of Time"?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We sang it in music class, so we won't have to practice too much for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Why don't you wanna practice?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I have to go to cram school and can't let practice sessions interfere with that.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh... My after school club has a tournament coming up, so I won't be able to make it to every practice...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I have work after school so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: See? Everyone has stuff going on in their lives, so we should just go for something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I see...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: But can't you see we're trying to drum up some enthusiasm here? Keep your downer excuses to yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You can't just expect everyone to drop everything because you want them to. Talk about selfish.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wh-What did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Waaaah!
Please don't fight...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all get along like we did during the Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You can train on your own for some sports, but everyone has to be together for something like this. Can't you see it's not the same?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah... I don't want to spend too much time on this.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I just think we should at least try to do it properly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh dear... Everyone's opinions are split and I don't think either side is willing to compromise.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Emu was trying so hard to get everyone to agree, too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm supposed to be managing this.
I have to do something...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, let's vote on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone should be fine with following what the majority of the class wants, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure... Why not?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: And it's probably the only way we can decide anything right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. This should settle the matter...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, let's vote.
Raise your hands for...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: 16? The same amount for both sides?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What? I thought we had 33 people in this class?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you didn't include yourself, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uhm...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Mochizuki hasn't voted yet.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Man, this is a real drag.
Hey, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Since you're in charge, why don't you decide?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're the only one who hasn't voted yet.
You can decide which song we'll sing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the bell just rang...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry, but I'm afraid we'll have to continue this discussion during next week's homeroom session.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Sigh... This should've been the easiest part.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I don't care which song we sing. Just pick something, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A tough song will be too much of an inconvenience for some, but a simple one will disappoint those who want a challenge...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What should I do...?
